scope: 29 Vietnamese Silver ticker candidates and selected high-risk VI company tags; identity verification only, not source-use clearance

normalization_policy.case: uppercase ticker aliases; preserve legal names as cited
normalization_policy.ticker_format: exact code as explicitly paired in cited official record; no inferred transformations
normalization_policy.relationships: issuer, parent, subsidiary and brand remain distinct; no relationship inferred

reference_policy: Only issuer/exchange or regulator disclosure records with an explicit security-code and issuer-name pairing are accepted. Dataset tags and frequency are not identity evidence.

source_files.note: Local fingerprint from R1; no source manifest, source URL or license. Used only to bind the audited candidate inventory.
R1 manifest-matched hash; selected review candidates bind to this source. Source-use remains subject to R1.
